assets.name: Natural Earth 1:110m Admin 0 Countries
assets.modifications: None. Original GeoJSON geometry and properties preserved.
limitations: Generalised 1:110m cartography omits some small countries and territories; the dataset's jurisdiction selector and table are the authoritative coverage views.
Natural Earth uses de facto boundaries. Cartographic boundaries and names are not statements of legal jurisdiction or endorsement of territorial claims.
The 177 geometry features are not a count of researched jurisdictions or recognised sovereign states.
ISO_A3 is -99 for France and Norway; ISO_A3_EH supplies FRA and NOR. Other non-ISO identifiers must remain explicit and must not be treated as assigned ISO codes.
Northern Ireland, supranational bodies, regional groups and global initiatives require explicit dataset treatment; they cannot be inferred from country polygons.
